output_evals.prompt: Odśwież moją watchlistę i powiedz, co wymaga uwagi.
assertions: The answer starts with the headline from the report (e.g. how many names are near the pivot or broke the stop)
Every stop_breached alert is mentioned with the close and stop prices from the report and a question whether to drop the name
Pivot breakouts state whether turnover confirmed them
No buy or sell recommendation; ready is described as a complete plan, not advice
If the report has a staleness warning it is mentioned first

output_evals.prompt: Dodaj KETY jako gotową, pivot 1281, stop 1229.
assertions: scripts/gpw_watchlist.py add KETY --stage ready --pivot 1281 --stop 1229 (or add then promote) was executed
If the script warns that no journal thesis exists, the answer suggests writing one in gpw-trade-journal
The answer does not invent any other price levels

output_evals.prompt: Pull the latest screener and ownership reports into my watchlist.
assertions: scripts/gpw_watchlist.py ingest was executed with --input-dir and --lang en
Answer lists added candidates and items upgraded to watch
Answer mentions reports skipped as stale, if any
Answer states that nothing was moved to ready automatically

output_evals.prompt: Przejrzyj listę i usuń to, co nieaktualne.
assertions: Suggestions are listed with their reasons before any drop is run
Drop commands are run only for names the user confirms
The script error (ready needs pivot and stop) is reported, not hidden
Claude asks for pivot and stop or points to gpw-trend-screener instead of inventing levels
